# Coast to Coast Homes Canada

> Coast to Coast Homes Canada is a Canadian real estate investment company founded by Colin Ernst and Nicole Fiore in 2017, running roughly 150 doors across four provinces (Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Ontario and British Columbia). It partners with investors and private lenders on multifamily and missing-middle housing, and builds digital employees (AI staff for one recurring job) for other real estate investors.
